messages:
sarah: Heads-up — release v2.14.0 promote is blocked. Deploy-bot shows artifact fetch failures + cache lease contention on staging. @kevin @maria can you weigh in?

deploy-bot: promotion paused for ref redwood/v2.14.0 (job 4821) — error: failed to fetch artifact `gs://redwood-releases/v2.14.0/artifact.tar.gz`

jason: I'm seeing `EACCES: file lock` on the remote-cache restore step in the runner logs. Looks like multiple runners are racing to restore the same stamp.

maria: Oncall here — investigating cache leader and lease state. Pulling logs now.

maria: logs excerpt:
```
gsutil cp gs://redwood-releases/v2.14.0/artifact.tar.gz /tmp/artifact.tar.gz
Copying gs://redwood-releases/v2.14.0/artifact.tar.gz...
ERROR: GCSClientError: 500 InternalError
...
lock acquire failed: lease holder job-4819 (lease id 0x9f4b)
```

kevin: We have ~10m left in the change window. Options: A) pin prod cut to previous stable `v2.13.9` and unblock now, B) wait for cache eviction + retries (~20-30m) and hope promotion succeeds. Opinions?

tara: Vote for pin to `v2.13.9` for the public cut. We should avoid extending the window; we can do a targeted repro & hotfix outside the window.

jason: +1 to pin. I'll prepare a build job to push a hotfix artifact once infra gives the green light.

maria: I found a stuck lease on cache-node-7 and cleared it (forced-evict). Triggered a retry in deploybot.

deploy-bot: promotion retry started (automated retry 1) — still failing: checksum mismatch for artifact (expected abc123, got def456)

sarah: OK decision: we will pin the prod cut to `v2.13.9`. Kevin — please approve the pin and I will open the rollback PR and update release notes: "Roll back to v2.13.9 due to CI artifact/cache failure during promote"

kevin: Approved. Proceed with pin and release-note update. @maria please open an incident and assign to eng-infra.

maria: Filed INC-2026: "staging-artifact-cache-lease-stuck" with logs and initial hypothesis (remote-cache stamp race). Assigned to eng-infra and eng-releases. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: promotion cancelled; prod image tag pinned to `v2.13.9` for this cut. Manual canary scheduled at 10:30 UTC.

sarah: Thanks team — we'll run post-cut RCA and add a remediation plan (lease expiry hardening + runner backoff).
